title: Direction of current
description: Essential: Student must state that current flows from a to b through resistor R, based on Lenz's law and right-hand rule analysis.

title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: Student must calculate E = 10 V using Faraday's law with correct N and slope from flux graph.

title: Voltage across resistor
description: Essential: Student must calculate U = 9.6 V using voltage divider or Ohm's law with total resistance.

title: Faraday's law application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply E = N·ΔΦ/Δt using the constant slope region from the flux-time graph.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: Student must treat coil as source with internal resistance r in series with R to find voltage division.

title: Lenz's law reasoning
description: Important: Student must connect decreasing inward flux to need for outward induced field, determining current direction.

title: Sign error in EMF
description: Pitfall: Student might use wrong sign in Faraday's law or misinterpret flux change direction, affecting current direction.

title: Resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Student might calculate U as E without accounting for internal resistance r of the coil.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes proper units (V, Ω) throughout calculations and final answers.
